meta.title: Chrome Extension
meta.description: Install the Tote Chrome extension to save products from any online store into organized collections with one click.
meta.ogDescription: Save products from any online store into Tote collections without copying links between tabs.

chromeExtension.title: Save from any store without breaking your flow.
chromeExtension.lead: The Tote browser extension captures product details while you shop, then sends each find to the collection where you are making the decision.
chromeExtension.heroAlt: Tote browser extension saving a product from an online store

capture.label: What it captures
capture.title: Enough detail to compare later.
capture.body: Tote reads the product page you are viewing and fills in the useful parts automatically. You can still edit the saved product in Tote when a store page is unusually sparse.
details: Product name, image, price, store, and source URL
Collection and slot selection before saving
Right-click saving for fast repeat captures
Sync with your Tote account across the web app and extension

workflows.label: How people use it
workflows.title: Built for the moment you find something worth saving.

items.title: Research without tab pileup
items.description: Save options as you browse, then close the tab knowing the link, image, and price are waiting in Tote.

items.title: Organize while the context is fresh
items.description: Choose the right collection and slot from the popup so every find lands where the decision is happening.

items.title: Come back ready to compare
items.description: Use Tote later to refresh prices, shortlist favorites, share a board, and move from maybe to decided.

docs.label: Need the details?
docs.title: Install, sign in, save, and troubleshoot.
docs.body: The extension guide covers permissions, pinning the toolbar icon, one-click saves, right-click saves, collection slots, and what to do when a store page does not expose complete product data.

final.label: Start saving
final.title: Give your next comparison a real home.
